text_block_list.text:
One day, while performing live shows
to bring about the revival of the Grand Live...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Unlike usual,
today will be a mini-live, but—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll give it my all no matter what live show it is!
Right, Bourbon-chan?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Bourbon-chan?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Calculating. Calculating the probability of achieving
today's objective: "Express Gratitude"—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey, stop calculating that!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't that something we should ask the customers?
We shouldn't just decide on our own!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Let's ask them directly after the concert is over!
I'm sure everyone will answer with a smile."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Setting new
end-of-routine command.
And the mini-live was a great success—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
How was it?! Today's live!
Did you become even more of a fan!?

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fan
text_block_list.text: Huh, yes... th-that's right.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san. Excess momentum detected.
Risk of status condition: 'Intimidation'.

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... But I've really become a fan.

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fan
text_block_list.text:
Her expression is completely different from how she looks during races,
and the feelings she conveys are different too, or rather...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...My feelings.

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It made me want to face those feelings
head-on even more.

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fan
text_block_list.text: "...It made me think that next time, I want to cheer my heart out at the live performance too."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Why don't you talk
with your fans once in a while?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"You might figure something out, you know?
Including what live performances mean to you."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if they really understand.

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, Suzuka-san was amazing today too, huh~
I wonder if she'll be performing in the next concert as well...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me. Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Suzuka-san!?
No way!? The real one!?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry.
There was something I wanted to ask you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, why are you so happy about it?
About me performing in the live show, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is it because you get to see
Suzuka-san in action, of course!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Still, you can always watch me run during the race, right?

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Fan
text_block_list.text:
That's true, but, um...
...all I can do is cheer during the race, after all.

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Fan
text_block_list.text:
It makes me happy that we can call out together.
To be in the same space, sharing the exact same feelings.

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Fan
text_block_list.text: ...Besides, it's a place where I can say 'welcome home.'

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Welcome back...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ! Yes, I'm home!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Suzuka-san?
You're back already?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... So you had a conversation
like that with a fan.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
“Still... it's strange, isn't it?
To think a live concert could be a place to say 'welcome home.'”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there was a time
when I said "welcome home" too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
As a fellow Umamusume in the same race,
Suzuka-san is someone whose back I want to catch up to, though.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"When I'm not running in a race—when I'm cheering—
all I can do is watch over them."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I see Suzuka-san off, my heart is pounding...
As I tell her, "Have a good race."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "Please come back safe and sound" ...she said.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So when the race ended and the live show started, I was just so happy. I waved my hands like crazy.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Saying, "Welcome back."
And, "Thank you for all your hard work in the race."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Saying, "Let's have lots of fun today."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... "Welcome home" sounds a bit like something a mom would say, though.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"When the concert begins, we return 'together' to that same place.
It makes me feel like I've finally come home."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Coming home...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... If I'm saying something
weird, I'm really sorry!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No... Thank you, Spe-chan.
Thanks to you, I feel like I understand a little better.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I'll try asking for a "Welcome home" too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Suzuka. Good timing.
Do you mind if I consult you about something?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove?
I don't really mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Truth is, a vacancy opened up among the runners for the student council's exhibition race. If possible, we'd like you to—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"No, there is a live performance for this race as well.
I must learn a new choreography for it."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "The race might be fine, but the Live must be a burden for you. I know you might refuse. But if it's possible at all..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fine by me. I'll learn the choreography for the concert too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Really!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Understood, I will prepare the registration right away.
Wait right there!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yes.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "...Because I believe a 'Welcome home' is waiting there, too."
